title: Appointed as Assistant
original: Doctor, watch your hands. If you aren't careful around my weapons, you'll get hurt.

title: Talk 1
original: Here are the instruments I used to play. There aren't too many of them, but the gems on them are very valuable. Sell them, and they should cover my medical fees... Once my debt's cleared, I'd like to go back to living on my own. Would that be alright?

title: Talk 2
original: I've seen pets kept around your hospital here, and you have a training room. I've seen some of the children you're giving intensive care in the wards. 'Instructor?' 'Professor?' My previous savior brought me to those with the same title, and look how I ended up.

title: Talk 3
original: This? This is my lyre. I may be better with other instruments, but I like playing this one most. Listen. Such an airy, lingering timbre, and the hand moves so beautifully when playing. But when you fully lose yourself in the melody, the knife concealed inside will... I'm sorry, I got carried away.

title: Talk after Promotion 1
original: Doctor, do you intend only to treat me here? Strange. You really don't need me to do anything? I can't trust kindness with no strings attached. Let me do a little something for you, okay? I'm sure you'll be satisfied, no matter the task—But, you must share with me your motivations.

title: Talk after Promotion 2
original: I remember coming back from my first fulfilled mission when I was young, weeping and throwing up, scared I didn't do well enough, that I would starve to death in some forgotten corner, unknown to anyone... No longer do I fear these things. Thanks to the days with Rhodes Island, I now know how it feels to be truly alive.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 1
original: The Originium on my arm... it hurts terribly, but it's much more manageable by now. I know none of the physicians, but I can tell how sincerely they're working to save me. Doctor, once my illness has stabilized to a point, can I... stay here?

title: Talk after Trust Increase 2
original: A lot of my past mistakes were made out of fear. I was scared—I felt that if I didn't listen to them, I was dead. But after catching Oripathy, they threw me out there to die. I should have been terrified at that moment, but instead I was... relieved. The sun shining on my face—it was so warm, it really was.

title: Talk after Trust Increase 3
original: Doctor, could you take me with you on your next field mission? I want to know the reasoning behind your every decision. Why did you save me, a stranger? Just what does my life mean to you...? I want to figure you out, just a little clearer.

title: Idle
original: All the ones before you would sleep with one eye open, when I was around. Do you... trust me that much?

title: Onboard
original: So you're the Doctor from Rhodes Island...? Thank you for what you did. I'll pay for my treatment in time. Otherwise, I'd like to be on my own for now.

title: Watching Battle Record
original: I'm a fast learner, don't worry.

title: Promotion 1
original: So this is how it feels... to hold my life in my own hands.

title: Promotion 2
original: This isn't the first time someone saves my life. But, if I had a chance to get back to those barrens, a chance to weigh up what's behind those helping hands again, I would choose to starve to death there. Doctor, I've been thinking... how nice it would've been, if you were there offering your hand instead.

title: Added to Squad
original: I trust your judgment. You won't lead me astray.

title: Appointed as Squad Leader
original: If I make any mistakes, please point them out to me.

title: Depart
original: Things are different. I don't want to hide myself any longer.

title: Begin Operation
original: It's them, right?

title: Selecting Operator 1
original: What is it?

title: Selecting Operator 2
original: I'm listening.

title: Deployment 1
original: In time, I'll find the right place for myself too.

title: Deployment 2
original: This is the position, right?

title: In Battle 1
original: I'm aware of what I'm doing.

title: In Battle 2
original: I know what it is I want.

title: In Battle 3
original: I obey my own heart.

title: In Battle 4
original: You've gone astray.

title: 4-star Result
original: That's one more step in the right direction, isn't it?

title: 3-star Result
original: Someday in the future, I'll have as clear a direction as you do.

title: Sub 3-star Result
original: We have a few runaways. A little like I once was.

title: Operation Failure
original: This isn't happening, don't abandon me... Doctor, where are you?

title: Assigned to Facility
original: Are you interested in my instruments? I can teach you how to play.

title: Tap
original: Ah! Doctor... that's dangerous.

title: Trust Tap
original: If I leave someday, you'll send me off, won't you?

title: Title
original: Arknights.

title: New Year's blessing
original: Such pretty fireworks... I used to think they were too far away, but here I am today, watching them lit below me. A single firework's just a tiny little thing, but there it goes, flying into the sky, blossoming into flowers so bright. Doctor, is that something I can aspire to?

title: Greeting
original: I heard the sound of your footsteps, Doctor.

title: Birthday
original: So today's your birthday... I don't even remember my own. Does my record in Medical note what day I was saved? I want that day to be my birthday. Doctor, I'll spend the day with you, so when my birthday comes, would you spend it with me?

title: Anniversary Celebration
original: They told me I was meant to be an assassin, twisted my life onto a path it never should've taken. But they never even gave me a reason, and I did far too much I never should have done. You've given me a new lease on life, and I'll be sure to use it well.
